text: A measurement yields g2(0) < 1 (antibunching). What does this establish?
choices: The light is non-classical: no classical field can produce g2(0) < 1
The light is simply very dim laser light
The detector is faulty, since g2(0) can never be below 1
explanation: Antibunching g2(0) < 1 is a strict non-classicality witness: every classical field obeys g2(0) >= 1, so a sub-unity value requires a non-classical state such as a single emitter. Dim laser light still has g2(0) = 1 (choice 1); the value is physically allowed, not an artifact (choice 2); thermal light has g2(0) = 2 (choice 3).
